tasks.instruction: Odpowiedz na pytania (1.1.-1.5.) dotyczace wiedzy o krajach anglojezycznych. Odpowiadaj po angielsku. W pytaniach oznaczonych 2 pkt nalezy podac dwie informacje.

items.question: Which American President delivered the Gettysburg Address?
In which year did the United States declare independence?
Who was the first person to walk on the Moon? In which year did it happen?
What was the name of the ship that carried the Pilgrims to America in 1620?
Which President was in office during the Cuban Missile Crisis of 1962?
